text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut is finally here, huh? ♪ My 
legend start-ins right here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's expecting her to run just like 
the pre-race hype. Ah, but... that's 
exactly why!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The challenger bug inside me is itching! I 
want to mess up big time and still run an 
amazing race! For example—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Going to buy a bento mid-race, and then 
winning on top of that!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come to understand Seeking the 
Pearl's personality quite well by now. 
That's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer!? On top of the table...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is a gem of a bento selection! 
Flavors from all over the world have... 
assembled!?
choice_data_list: You can eat whichever one you like.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Splendid work, Trainer! With you 
anticipating my moves so perfectly, I have 
no reason to run off course.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fine. In that case, I'll run fair and 
square. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I will show her. I'll show that Umamusume 
watching in the stands just what my 
running is capable of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who came to spectate. That 
would be, of course—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I knew you'd come to watch, Taiki. 
And naturally so. Because our generation 
is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—A pure match race between you and me. 
Likely no one else will be able to keep 
up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That is why it is critical that I 
demonstrate it to you right here and now. 
Yes—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just look at how eXXXcellent my running 
is! Take this, my super-intense greeting!
